args.title: Fix malformed row error due to trailing blank line in parseStatement
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change the parseStatement function so it correctly ignores a final empty line after splitting. This prevents assertShape from failing on files with a trailing blank line, which causes the 'Malformed row' error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseStatement function removes a final empty line but still processes all lines, causing a 'Malformed row' error when the last line is blank. Files ending with a blank line fail to import because the column count does not match the header. This PR fixes that issue.
